data.name: Description
data.value: Hosting made for borg. With an API token BorgStudio creates the repository, registers the login key and shows the quota; without one, both are set up in BorgBase's web interface.

data.name: TokenHint
data.value: Created at borgbase.com under Account → API; “Create Only” is enough. Kept in the vault. Leave empty to set up the key by hand.

data.name: RepoHint
data.value: With a token: the repository's name at BorgBase (found, or created for a new repository). Without: its address from BorgBase, e.g. ssh://abcd1234@abcd1234.repo.borgbase.com/./repo

data.name: RepoRequired
data.value: Please enter the repository's name or address.

data.name: RegionHint
data.value: Where BorgBase creates a new repository.

data.name: AddressNeeded
data.value: Without an API token, please enter the repository's address from BorgBase (ssh://…).

data.name: RepoNotFound
data.value: BorgBase has no repository „{0}“. Choose “Create a new repository” to have it created.

data.name: TokenRefused
data.value: BorgBase refused the API token (expired, or without the needed permission).
